# Sister Ilva

## Overview

Found waiting at the top of [[Cinder Steps]], alone, dry, and unsurprised.

## Meeting on the Steps (Session 4)

Asked the crew nothing at all. Offered water. Did not give a house or an order when
asked which she belonged to.

## Mysteries

- How long she had been there.
- Why nothing in the marsh had troubled her.

## Notes

The crew's accounts of her differ on the colour of her habit, which is the sort of
detail three people do not usually disagree about.
